annotations.title: Plan pausing or resuming several sites

description: Use this when the user wants to pause or resume several sites at once: a group, a list of sites, or every site, for example during a migration or a move to a new host. Returns exactly which sites would change, which are already paused or running, and which can't be changed (no permission, shared from another account, or no room on the plan to resume), with a plan id. Changes nothing. Not for one site or one of its checks (use set_monitor_paused), or for planned work with an end time on one site (draft_maintenance).

all.description: True for every site the user can change.

answers.description: The user's answers, by decision id: which sites a name that matched several means.

paused.description: True to pause, false to resume.

plan_id.description: An earlier plan_bulk_pause plan, to answer its decisions.

sites.description: Sites by id, name or part of their URL, up to 100.

name: plan_bulk_pause
